title: The Last Digit of 7²⁰²⁶
statement: What is the last digit of $7^{2026}$?
insight: Last digits of powers of 7 cycle with period 4: 7, 9, 3, 1.
redHerring: Reaching for Euler's theorem mod 10 when a short cycle is visible directly.
hints: Write out the last digits of $7^1, 7^2, 7^3, 7^4, 7^5$.
The pattern repeats every 4. What is $2026 \bmod 4$?
solution: Last digits of $7^n$: $7, 9, 3, 1, 7, \dots$, period 4. Since $2026 = 4\cdot506 + 2$, the last digit matches $7^2 = 49$: it is $9$.
